law_record.title: Traffic controlled by official traffic-control devices (8)(d)
law_record.text: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: After complying with the requirement to stop, a person driving a motorcycle, moped or trimobile or riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter may proceed straight through or turn right or left if: (1) The person waits for two complete cycles of the lights or lighted arrows of the applicable official traffic-control device and the signal does not change because of a malfunction or because the signal failed to detect the presence of the motorcycle, moped, trimobile, bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter; (2) No other device at the place prohibits either or both such turns, if applicable; and (3) The person yields the right-of-way to pedestrians and other traffic proceeding as directed by the signal at the intersection.

activation_conditions: the subject rides a motorcycle, moped, trimobile, bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter
a steady red signal alone faces it
the subject has stopped and waited two complete signal cycles without the signal changing
exceptions: no other device at the place prohibits the movement
the permission is conditional on yielding to pedestrians and other traffic proceeding as directed
residue: whether the signal failed 'because of a malfunction or because it failed to detect' the machine is a cause, not an observation; the observable substitute is that two cycles passed with no change
summary.subject: rider

timing_requirements.requirement: two complete cycles of the device must elapse while the subject waits — the longest explicit wait in the corpus
the trace must cover both cycles, so a short clip cannot establish the permission
stop, wait two cycles, then proceed
